name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(switch_toggled) is not required because the hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) forces switch_toggled to occur eventually after the siren starts ringing. The machine correctly models this by transitioning from u0 to u1 when the siren rings and back to u0 when the switch is toggled.

texts: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
